messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "keep until the expiration date printed on the label"
set: ["keep until the expiration date printed on the label", "do not use after the expiration date", "check the instructions on the label", "always check the strength printed on your own bottle or packet", "keep the cap on when not in use", "follow directions on prescription label", "pharmacist will write date on bottle", "keep using the medication as directed", "follow directions on prescription label carefully", "keep taking the medicine as directed", "use exactly as directed on the label or as prescribed by your doctor", "patchy darkening of the skin on the face", "working directly on the nerves", "stay within the recommended daily limit on the packet", "give the next dose on the regularly scheduled day", "administer the next dose on the regularly scheduled day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
